settings.heading: BAC Estimator
settings.effect_02: Mild change, may seem slightly elated.
settings.effect_05: Drivers hesitant: alternate from 'who cares?' to impulsive aggression.
settings.effect_08: Ability to accurately steer, brake, and judge distance impaired. Legally considered drunk.
settings.effect_10: Judgment seriously affected, coordination impaired. Legally under influence.
settings.effect_30: Stuporous. Severe central nervous system depression.
settings.effect_40: Unconscious. Possibly in coma and verge of death.
settings.disclaimer_text: ESTIMATE ONLY. Do not use to assess ability to drive.
